messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Auto-page from PagerDuty: service=inference-edge, alert=5XX_RATE_SPIKE, condition=5xx_rate>3% over 5m, severity=critical, incident=https://pd.example/INC67890

oncall-zoe: acked. i'll take primary. tagging SRE + ENG. starting triage.

sre-ram: on it. pulling up edge metrics and trace samples. region=us-west2 shows most of the spike. 502/504 majority.

eng-kai: i merged a tiny perf tweak to edge-proxy earlier this deploy window (commit: 9f2a3b). reverting now in case it's causal.

infra-omar: infra view: increased upstream conn-reset rate to kvcache-proxy replicas in us-west2; connection errors align with the spike window.

support-lee: queue: multiple customers reporting failed requests, notably "maps-instant" and "chatflow" test orgs — both on us-west2 endpoints. escalating to account teams.

oncall-zoe: mitigation plan: 1) isolate canary traffic, 2) fail traffic to stable pool, 3) rollback edge-proxy tweak if needed, 4) scale stable frontends. executing step 1 now.

eng-kai: isolating canary via routing rule (set weight 0). command:
```
# set canary traffic to 0
redwoodctl routes update --route edge --env prod --set-weight canary=0
```

eng-kai: initiating rollback to previous release (rev 228 -> 227).
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=227
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=edge-proxy -w
```

infra-omar: scaling stable frontends from 10 -> 18 replicas to absorb burst. also bumping kvcache-proxy conn limits:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/kvcache-proxy --replicas=6
kubectl -n infra exec svc/kvcache-config -- sh -c "echo \"max_conns=4096\" > /etc/kvcache/conf.d/override.conf && kill -HUP 1"
```

sre-ram: i'm enabling a short fail-open timeout on edge to let requests through if kv lookup stalls: set KV_TIMEOUT_MS=60 (was 20) for the stable pool. applying now.

pd-bot: PD update: INC67890 acknowledged by oncall-zoe; responders=[oncall-zoe,sre-ram,eng-kai,infra-omar].

(6 minutes later)
sre-ram: smoke test from us-west2 should return 200 now, running curl:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/health -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>"
# -> 200 0.231s
```

support-lee: informal check with "chatflow" shows reduced failures, they've seen success on 3/3 attempts. pinged their SRE to confirm.

eng-kai: rollback complete and pods stable. logs show prior "upstream reset" traces decreased.

sre-ram: metrics: us-west2 5xx rate down from 4.8% -> 0.9% in last 5m; latency p95 slightly elevated during scale but stable now.

oncall-zoe: good. moving to monitoring phase. will keep PD incident open for 30m of stable metrics.

infra-omar: note: a kvcache proxy upgrade earlier this week had a config that lowered default max_conns for certain clients; looks like under increased small-lookup load we hit limits. adding to follow-ups.

pd-bot: PD update: INC67890 status=monitoring (oncall-zoe).

pm note (support-lee): customer impact summary draft: region=us-west2, timeframe=~12m from 1768614260->1768614980, estimated affected traffic=~1.8% of total, major customers: maps-instant (partial failures), chatflow (intermittent). no data leakage.

eng-kai: follow-ups assigned: 1) add client-side kv lookup batching, 2) add canary traffic auto-hold when 5xx > 0.5% for 3m, 3) audit kvcache proxy conn defaults. i'll own 1+2.

sre-ram: i'll write a runbook subsection for rapid route-weight swap and add an alert to silo canary autopages to lower-noise channel.

oncall-zoe: marking incident as resolved in PD if monitoring shows stable for 30m. posting an internal blurb and scheduling a postmortem tomorrow. thanks all. :heart:

pd-bot: PD update: INC67890 status=resolved by oncall-zoe at 1768616100 — alert closed, monitoring window passed.

oncall-zoe: closing here. postmortem owners: eng-kai + sre-ram + infra-omar. will produce customer-facing note via support-lee. :white_check_mark:
